author: Captain Rina Okoye
content: CSS Horizon docked at Lagrange Station L5-Prime for resupply leg two. Manifest verified against station manifest — 840 tonnes dry goods, 120 tonnes cryo-fuel. Berth 7-C secured. Survey shuttle prepped for detached asteroid belt run.

author: Chief Engineer Yuki Sato
content: Main drive output holding at 91% during station-side power draw. Cargo hold pressure stable at 101.2 kPa. Minor leak detected in docking seal ring 3 — patched with emergency sealant, monitoring integrity at 89%.

author: Dr. Mateo Alvarez
content: Pre-survey briefing for Cluster Theta-9: spectroscopy suggests nickel-iron rubble with trace platinum group metals. Recommend low-thrust approach along the L4 drift lane. Requesting 18-hour detached ops window after fuel top-off.

author: Ensign Priya Nair
content: Night shift: crane cycle completed for pallet batch 14–19. Station traffic control cleared Horizon for undock at 0600. Life support O2 mix nominal. Background radiation within expected L5 shielding envelope.

author: Dr. Helena Weiss
content: Pre-undock health screening complete. Two crew flagged for mild decompression fatigue after extended EVA prep — cleared for light duty only. Updated quarantine protocols for returned core samples per station directive 44-B.

author: Lt. Omar Farouk
content: Undock from L5-Prime complete. Plotting transfer burn to Theta-9 survey box. Convoy channel reserved on nav beacon 7. ETA to survey coordinates: 14 hours at economical thrust.

author: Lt. Jonas Kline
content: Security sweep before detached survey: cargo bay sealed, access logs reviewed. No unauthorized manifests. Posted watch on external grapple ports during sample intake window.

author: Specialist Anika Desai
content: First core sample from Theta-9 fragment T9-04 shows elevated cobalt and nickel. Mass spectrometer calibration drifted 0.3% — recalibrated. Recommending second core from the sunward face.

author: Chief Engineer Yuki Sato
content: Docking seal ring 3 integrity improved to 94% after replacement gasket install. Main drive output restored to 96% post-calibration. Cargo hold pressure holding steady through sample loading vibration.

author: Captain Rina Okoye
content: Theta-9 survey phase one complete. Sample yield exceeds contract minimum by 22%. Approved return leg to L5-Prime for offload. Next convoy slot reserved in 36 hours.

author: Lt. Cmdr. Fatima Rahman
content: Return approach to L5-Prime filed. Traffic congestion near berth 7 — requesting alternate berth 9-A. Fuel reserves sufficient with 8% margin after survey detour.

author: Ensign Luca Romano
content: Pre-dock checklist: life support O2 at 20.9%, cargo hold pressure green, background radiation nominal. Pump test on cryo line 2 passed. Standing by for coupling with station refueling arm.
